summary.value: Amended the Rent Ordinance to, among other things, prohibit (with exceptions) rent increases based on the addition of occupants, prevent evictions based on the addition of occupants if the landlord unreasonably refused the tenant's written request, and require a Rent Board form in six languages to be attached to each notice to vacate.

citations.quote: 1) prohibit, with certain exceptions, rent increases based on the addition of occupants even where a pre-existing rental agreement or lease permits such an increase; 2) prevent evictions based on the addition of occupants if the landlord has unreasonably refused the tenant's written request
9) require the Rent Board to prepare a form in English, Chinese, Spanish, Vietnamese, Tagalog, and Russian stating that a notice to vacate may lead to a lawsuit to evict
10) require landlords to attach a copy of the Rent Board form in the primary language of the tenant to each notice to vacate
